name: Django Web Development with Django REST Framework
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
Python Institute PCAP: Certified Associate Python Programmer (Python foundation)

beginner.summary: For Python developers starting web development. Covers Django projects and apps, URLs and views, templates, models and the ORM, migrations, the admin, QuerySets, forms, class-based views, static and media files, authentication, permissions, relationships, sessions and messages, pagination and search, email, testing with pytest-django, REST APIs with Django REST Framework and deployment with Gunicorn, NGINX and PostgreSQL.
prerequisites: Writes Python functions, classes and modules
Understands what a database table is
outcomes: Use the ORM, forms, admin and authentication
Expose REST APIs with Django REST Framework

days.topic: Django Overview, Project Setup and First App
subtopics: The model, template and view pattern
Creating a virtual environment and installing Django
Creating a first app and view
days.lab_task: Create a Django project for an event booking site in a virtual environment, add an events app with a home page view, run the development server and explore the settings and folder layout.
days.deliverable: Running project skeleton in a Git repository
checks: Home page loads from the events app
Project and app files described correctly
Django version pinned in the requirements file

days.topic: URLs, Views and Responses
days.lab_task: Add URLs and views for event lists, event details by slug and a search query, use named URLs everywhere and return 404 for unknown events.
checks: Detail view shows the right event
Links still work through reverse and named URLs

days.topic: Templates and Template Inheritance
days.lab_task: Build a base layout with navigation and blocks, event list and detail templates with filters for dates and prices, a reusable event card partial and one custom filter.
checks: All pages share the base layout
Prices formatted by the custom filter
Script in an event title shown as text

days.topic: Models and the Django ORM
subtopics: Field options: null, blank, default and choices
Querying with objects.all, filter and get
days.lab_task: Model events, venues and categories with suitable fields and choices, create and query records in the shell and move a business rule into a model method.

days.topic: Migrations and Database Changes
days.lab_task: Add and rename fields with migrations, write a data migration that fills a new slug field, resolve a migration conflict from a teammate and move the project to PostgreSQL.
checks: Every event has a unique slug
Merge migration applied and tests pass
Site runs on PostgreSQL with all data
objectives: Work with migrations in a team

days.topic: The Django Admin
subtopics: When not to use the admin
days.lab_task: Build an admin for events, venues and bookings with filters, search, inline tickets, a bulk publish action and staff users who can edit only events.
checks: Staff find events by date, venue and name
Selected events published in one step

days.topic: QuerySets: Filtering, Ordering and Aggregation
subtopics: Lookups such as contains, gte and in
Aggregation with Count, Sum and Avg
days.lab_task: Write QuerySets for upcoming events by category, events with seats left, bookings per venue and revenue per month, and check the SQL with django-debug-toolbar.
checks: Q objects return events matching either condition
Debug toolbar shows the generated SQL

days.topic: Forms and ModelForms
subtopics: Handling POST and redirect after success
days.lab_task: Build a booking form with a ModelForm, validate seat limits in clean methods, show errors, protect it with CSRF and redirect after success, then add a formset for multiple attendees.
checks: Form shows the seat limit error
Formset saves several attendees at once

days.topic: Class-Based Views and Generic Views
subtopics: Function views compared with class-based views
Choosing between function and class views
days.lab_task: Rewrite the event pages with ListView, DetailView, CreateView, UpdateView and DeleteView, filter the list in get_queryset and add a mixin that sets the organiser.
days.deliverable: Event views built from generic views
checks: Organiser set automatically by the mixin
get_queryset limits events to upcoming ones

days.topic: Static Files, Media and Image Uploads
days.lab_task: Add event banner uploads with validation and resizing, serve static files with WhiteNoise, collect static files for production and show banners on event cards.
days.deliverable: Image upload feature and static configuration
checks: Resized banner shown on the event card

days.topic: User Authentication: Login, Logout and Sign-Up
days.lab_task: Add sign-up, login, logout and password reset, protect booking pages with login_required and show the signed-in user's bookings.
checks: New user signs up and sees their bookings
Reset email sent and password changed
Open a protected page signed out

days.topic: Permissions and Groups
subtopics: Groups for organisers, staff and attendees
days.lab_task: Create organiser and staff groups with permissions, let organisers edit only their own events, hide edit buttons from other users and test the rules.

days.topic: Relationships: ForeignKey, ManyToMany and OneToOne
days.lab_task: Add speakers to events with a many-to-many through model, user profiles with one-to-one fields, query events by speaker and cut the query count on the list page.
days.deliverable: Related models and optimised list page
checks: Speakers linked with their session times

days.topic: Messages, Sessions and Cookies
days.lab_task: Show success and error messages across the site, build a session-based ticket basket, remember a preferred city and set secure cookie flags.
checks: Success message appears once after booking
Session cookie is HttpOnly and Secure in production settings

days.topic: Pagination, Search and Filtering
subtopics: Search with icontains and Q objects
Keeping filters in the query string
days.lab_task: Add pagination, search and filters by category, city and date to the event list, keep filters in the URL across pages and add sorting.
checks: Filters stay applied on every page
Matching events returned by name and description
Events sorted by date or price

days.topic: Sending Email from Django
subtopics: Email backends for development and production
Sending from a transactional email service
Avoiding slow requests when sending email
days.lab_task: Send booking confirmation emails with HTML templates and a PDF ticket attachment, test them with Mailpit and send through a transactional email service in staging.
checks: Confirmation email arrives with the ticket attached
Test asserts the email subject and recipient

days.topic: Testing Django Apps with pytest-django
days.lab_task: Write tests for models, forms, views and permissions with factory_boy, use the test client for booking flows and reach 80 percent coverage.
checks: Test client books a ticket end to end

days.topic: REST APIs with Django REST Framework
subtopics: Why and when to add an API
days.lab_task: Expose events and bookings through a DRF API with ModelSerializers, ViewSets, routers, token authentication, permissions and pagination, and test it from Postman.
days.deliverable: REST API with a Postman collection

days.topic: Deploying Django with Gunicorn, NGINX and PostgreSQL
subtopics: NGINX as reverse proxy and static server
days.lab_task: Deploy the site to a Linux server with Gunicorn, NGINX, PostgreSQL and HTTPS, pass the deployment checklist and restart automatically with systemd.

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Event Booking Website
days.lab_task: Complete the event booking site with events, bookings, uploads, authentication, permissions, search, email, an API, tests and a production deployment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL and demo recording
checks: Browsing, booking and organiser flows work end to end
API returns events and accepts bookings
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project

intermediate.summary: For developers who already build Django sites. Covers settings for multiple environments, custom user models, ORM performance, transactions and constraints, DRF serializers, viewsets and routers in depth, API authentication with tokens and JWT, permissions and throttling, Celery and Redis, caching, signals and middleware, async views and ASGI, Django Channels, HTMX, PostgreSQL full-text search, S3 storage, security hardening, testing in depth, Docker and CI/CD, and monitoring with Sentry.
prerequisites: Has built and deployed a Django site with models, forms and authentication
Comfortable with Python classes and decorators
outcomes: Structure and tune Django projects for production
Build secure, well-tested APIs with DRF
Add background jobs, caching, real-time and search features
Containerise, deploy and monitor Django services

days.topic: Project Structure and Settings for Multiple Environments
days.lab_task: Split settings into base, development, test and production, load secrets from the environment, restructure apps by feature and add a custom system check for required settings.
checks: Custom system check stops start-up with a clear message
Each environment loads its own settings
Apps grouped by feature with clear ownership

days.topic: Custom User Models and Authentication Backends
subtopics: Why to start with a custom user model
Migrating an existing project to a custom user
days.lab_task: Create a custom user model with email login, add Google sign-in with django-allauth and two-factor authentication, and plan how an existing project would move to a custom user.
days.deliverable: Custom user model with social login and 2FA
checks: Users sign in with email and password
allauth creates and links the account
Login asks for a one-time code

days.topic: ORM Performance: select_related, prefetch_related and Query Expressions
days.lab_task: Find and fix N+1 queries on three pages, use F expressions for seat counts, add subqueries for latest booking dates and replace a loop of saves with bulk operations.
days.deliverable: Optimised queries with before and after counts
checks: Page query counts drop to a fixed number

days.topic: Database Transactions, Constraints and Indexes in Django
days.lab_task: Make booking safe under concurrency with atomic blocks and select_for_update, enforce rules with database constraints, add conditional indexes and send emails only after commit.
days.deliverable: Safe booking logic with constraints and tests
checks: Email sent only when the transaction commits

days.topic: DRF in Depth: Serializers, ViewSets and Routers
days.lab_task: Build a full API for events, sessions and bookings with nested writable serializers, custom actions, filters, optimised querysets and OpenAPI docs from drf-spectacular.
checks: Event with sessions created in one request
Cancel action changes status and returns the booking

days.topic: API Authentication with Tokens, JWT and Sessions in DRF
days.lab_task: Support session login for the site, JWT with refresh and blacklisting for a mobile app and API keys for a partner, and test all three.
checks: New access token issued from the refresh token
Partner request accepted with a valid key

days.topic: API Permissions, Throttling and Filtering
subtopics: Throttling by user and by IP
days.lab_task: Add object-level permissions so organisers manage only their events, scoped throttles for booking, search and ordering filters, and tests for each rule.
days.deliverable: Permission and throttle configuration with tests
checks: Results filtered and ordered as requested

days.topic: Background Tasks with Celery and Redis
subtopics: Task results and monitoring with Flower
days.lab_task: Move emails and report generation to Celery tasks with retries, schedule reminder tasks with Celery Beat, make tasks idempotent and monitor them with Flower.
checks: Email sent by a worker without slowing the response
Task retries and then records the failure
Reminder task runs at the scheduled time

days.topic: Caching with Redis and the Django Cache Framework
days.lab_task: Cache the home page fragments, popular event queries and API list responses in Redis, invalidate on updates and measure response times and hit rates.
checks: Cached pages respond faster under load
Cached data refreshed after the change

days.topic: Signals, Middleware and the Request Lifecycle
subtopics: How a request flows through Django
When signals make code harder to follow
days.lab_task: Add middleware for request IDs and timing, a context processor for site settings, a signal that creates profiles for new users, and replace one confusing signal with explicit code.
days.deliverable: Middleware, context processor and signal changes
checks: Each response carries a request ID and duration

days.topic: Async Django: Async Views and ASGI
subtopics: When async helps and when it does not
days.lab_task: Write an async view that calls three external APIs concurrently, run Django under Uvicorn, use the async ORM interface and compare latency with the sync version.
checks: Latency close to the slowest API call

days.topic: Real-Time Features with Django Channels
subtopics: Sending events from views and tasks
days.lab_task: Add live seat availability and organiser notifications with Channels, broadcast updates from bookings and Celery tasks, authenticate sockets and test consumers.
checks: Other viewers see seats update instantly
Consumer test sends and receives messages

days.topic: HTMX with Django for Interactive Pages
subtopics: Inline editing and search as you type
When to choose HTMX over a JavaScript framework
days.lab_task: Add search as you type, inline editing of bookings, infinite scroll and inline form validation to the site with HTMX and partial templates, without writing JavaScript.
checks: Results update without a full page reload
No custom JavaScript written for these features
objectives: Choose between HTMX and SPA frameworks

days.topic: Full-Text Search with PostgreSQL in Django
subtopics: When to use a search engine instead
days.lab_task: Add ranked full-text search over events with weighted fields, a stored search vector with a GIN index, trigram matching for typos and a search API endpoint.
checks: Trigram search finds the intended event
Title matches rank above description matches

days.topic: File Storage on S3 with django-storages
subtopics: django-storages with Amazon S3 or compatible stores
Static files on S3 and a CDN
days.lab_task: Move media to S3 with django-storages, keep tickets private with signed URLs, serve static files through a CDN and develop locally against MinIO.
checks: File stored in S3 and shown on the site
Signed URL works and then expires
objectives: Serve static files from a CDN

days.topic: Security Hardening for Django: OWASP Risks and the Deployment Checklist
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues: raw SQL injection, unsafe mark_safe, missing HSTS and open CORS, add django-axes, and scan with Bandit and pip-audit.
checks: Injection attempt no longer changes the query
No high-severity Bandit or pip-audit findings

days.topic: Testing in Depth: Factories, Mocks and API Tests
days.lab_task: Extend the suite with factories and traits, API tests for every endpoint, Celery task tests, time-frozen reminder tests and mocked payment calls, and run it in parallel.
checks: Every endpoint covered by APIClient tests
Reminder tests pass for fixed dates
Suite time drops with parallel workers

days.topic: Docker and CI/CD for Django
subtopics: Docker Compose with PostgreSQL, Redis and Celery
Deploying to a server or a platform
days.lab_task: Containerise the project with Compose services for web, worker, beat, PostgreSQL and Redis, build a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests and builds images and deploys with migrations.
checks: All services healthy with one command
Tests, build and deploy stages pass

days.topic: Logging, Monitoring and Error Tracking with Sentry
days.lab_task: Add structured logging, Sentry error and performance monitoring, health checks for web and workers, and uptime alerts, then respond to a simulated outage.
checks: Error appears in Sentry with request details
Health endpoint reports database and Redis status
Outage detected and resolved with notes

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Multi-User Project Tracker with API
days.lab_task: Build a project tracker with a custom user model, teams and permissions, a documented API, background jobs, real-time updates, search, tests, containers, CI/CD and monitoring, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL, test reports and presentation
checks: Teams, tasks and live updates work end to end
Tests, security scans and performance results meet targets
Data, API and deployment choices explained
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product

advanced.summary: For senior Django engineers and technical leads. Covers Django internals, large codebases and service layers, multi-tenancy, database routing and replicas, performance engineering, advanced Celery workflows, event-driven Django, GraphQL, zero-downtime migrations, OIDC and security architecture, Kubernetes, cloud hosting choices, OpenTelemetry, API governance, LTS upgrades, reusable packages, data-heavy features, AI features with pgvector and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building production Django applications
Strong Python, PostgreSQL and DRF skills
Has deployed and operated Django in production
outcomes: Architect large and multi-tenant Django platforms
Secure, observe and upgrade Django estates
Lead Django teams and technical decisions

days.topic: Django Internals: ORM Compiler, Middleware Chain and App Loading
days.lab_task: Step through a request from WSGI to the view in the debugger, trace how a QuerySet compiles to SQL, write a custom lookup and explain app loading order problems.
days.deliverable: Internals notebook with a custom lookup
checks: Each middleware and handler step identified

days.topic: Large Django Codebases: Apps, Boundaries and Service Layers
days.lab_task: Introduce service and selector layers into a large project, enforce app boundaries with import-linter, replace direct cross-app calls with domain events and record the decisions.
checks: import-linter fails on a forbidden import

days.topic: Multi-Tenant Django with Schemas or Row-Level Isolation
subtopics: Shared schema with tenant foreign keys
days.lab_task: Build the same feature with schema-per-tenant and shared-schema models, resolve tenants by domain, keep cache keys and Celery tasks tenant-aware and prove isolation with tests.
days.deliverable: Multi-tenant design comparison and isolation tests
checks: No cross-tenant data in views, APIs or tasks

days.topic: Scaling Django: Database Routing, Read Replicas and Connection Pooling
subtopics: Connection pooling with PgBouncer or the built-in pool
days.lab_task: Route reads to a replica while keeping read-after-write consistency, pool connections, partition the bookings table and load test to find the new limit.
checks: Reads go to the replica except after a user's own writes
No connection errors at peak load
Queries on recent bookings scan only recent partitions

days.topic: Performance Engineering: Profiling Queries and Views at Scale
subtopics: Performance budgets for pages and APIs
days.lab_task: Profile the slowest page and API, fix query plans, serializer and template costs, tune Gunicorn workers, and show gains under load with Locust.
days.deliverable: Performance report with before and after results
checks: Hot spots identified with profiler output
API response time lower for the same data

days.topic: Advanced Celery: Workflows, Retries and Monitoring
subtopics: Alternatives such as Dramatiq and RQ
days.lab_task: Build a report pipeline with chains and chords, route heavy tasks to their own queue, handle late acknowledgements correctly and alert on queue backlogs.
checks: Final task runs after all parallel tasks finish
Alert fires when the queue grows

days.topic: Event-Driven Django with Kafka or RabbitMQ
subtopics: Events between Django and other services
Publishing events reliably with an outbox
Consumers as management commands or workers
days.lab_task: Publish booking events through an outbox, consume them in a separate analytics service idempotently, route failures to a dead letter queue and evolve the event schema safely.
days.deliverable: Event-driven integration with an event catalogue
checks: Message lands in the dead letter queue
Old and new consumers keep working

days.topic: GraphQL APIs with Strawberry for Django
subtopics: When GraphQL fits a Django product
days.lab_task: Add a GraphQL API for the dashboard with Strawberry, batch loading with DataLoaders, permissions and depth limits, and run it next to the existing DRF API.
checks: Nested query runs a fixed small number of SQL queries

days.topic: Zero-Downtime Migrations on Large Tables
days.lab_task: Rename and restructure a column on a large table with expand and contract, add an index concurrently, backfill in batches during traffic and lint migrations in CI.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, scripts and release notes
checks: No table lock during index creation
Backfill completes with no latency spike

days.topic: Security Architecture: OIDC, Secrets and Audit Trails
days.lab_task: Add SSO through an OIDC provider, load secrets from Vault, encrypt sensitive fields, record audit trails for admin actions and threat model the platform.
checks: Users sign in through the identity provider
Sensitive fields unreadable in the database
Admin changes recorded with user and time

days.topic: Django on Kubernetes
subtopics: Deployments for web, workers and beat
Static and media files on Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Package web, worker and beat as a Helm chart, run migrations as a job, add probes and graceful shutdown, autoscale workers on queue length and prove a rollout drops no requests.
checks: No failed requests during the rollout
Migration job completes before new pods serve traffic

days.topic: Hosting Django on AWS or Azure: Containers, Serverless and Managed Services
subtopics: AWS: ECS Fargate, App Runner and RDS
Azure: Container Apps, App Service and Azure Database for PostgreSQL
Secrets and identity in the cloud
days.lab_task: Deploy the platform to one AWS and one Azure option with managed PostgreSQL and Redis, compare effort, performance and cost and write a hosting recommendation.
checks: Recommendation covers risk, cost and team skills

days.topic: Observability with OpenTelemetry for Django
subtopics: Tracing ORM queries, Celery tasks and HTTP calls
days.lab_task: Instrument web and workers with OpenTelemetry, trace a booking through Django, PostgreSQL and Celery, define an SLO for booking and alert on burn rate.
days.deliverable: Observability setup with SLO and dashboards
checks: One trace covers view, database and task
Alert fires during a simulated failure

days.topic: API Governance at Scale: Versioning, Pagination and Contracts with drf-spectacular
subtopics: API design guidelines for many teams
days.lab_task: Write API guidelines, lint the OpenAPI schema with Spectral rules, version two endpoints, detect breaking changes in CI and publish a deprecation notice.
checks: Spectral rules pass for all endpoints
CI fails on a breaking change

days.topic: Upgrading Django Across LTS Releases
subtopics: Running with deprecation warnings as errors
Upgrading Python at the same time
days.lab_task: Upgrade a project from one Django LTS release to the next, fix deprecations with warnings as errors, upgrade third-party apps and roll out with a staged deployment.
checks: Test run with warnings as errors passes
Third-party apps compatible with the new version

days.topic: Building Reusable Django Packages
subtopics: When to extract a reusable app
Templates and static files in packages
days.lab_task: Extract an audit app into a reusable package with configurable settings and migrations, test it against two Django versions and publish it to a private index.
checks: Another project installs and uses it
Tests pass on both Django versions

days.topic: Data-Heavy Django: Reporting, Exports and Analytics
days.lab_task: Build a reporting module with materialised views, streamed exports of a million rows, background report jobs and charts, served from a read-only connection.
checks: Million-row export starts immediately and completes
Materialised view refreshes without blocking readers
Dashboard charts load from the read-only connection

days.topic: AI Features in Django: LLM APIs, pgvector and Background Jobs
subtopics: AI use cases in Django products
days.lab_task: Add semantic search over events with pgvector, an assistant that answers questions from event content with streaming responses, background embedding jobs and cost tracking.
checks: Relevant events found without shared keywords
Answer streams to the page with sources

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production Django Incidents
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: a missing index after a release, worker memory growth, a stuck Celery queue and connection exhaustion, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Tenant SaaS on Django
days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-tenant SaaS on Django with service layers, tenant isolation, replicas, event-driven integration, zero-downtime migrations, SSO, AI search and SLOs, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, architecture document and defence
checks: Load test meets the agreed SLOs
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
